scripts.build:desktop: tsc -p tsconfig.json && vite build --mode capacitor --outDir dist-desktop
scripts.build:apk: tsc -p tsconfig.json && vite build --mode capacitor && cap sync android
scripts.android:add: vite build --mode capacitor && cap add android && capacitor-assets generate --android --iconBackgroundColor '#08080F' --iconBackgroundColorDark '#08080F' --splashBackgroundColor '#08080F' --splashBackgroundColorDark '#08080F'
scripts.apk:debug: npm run build:apk && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.apk:release: npm run build:apk && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.test: node --test teste/sessao.test.mjs teste/ajustes.test.mjs teste/empresa.test.mjs teste/voz.test.mjs teste/marketing.test.mjs teste/trava.test.mjs
